executiveSummary: The September 4 recovery switched serving back to the existing High Intent Colorado Springs campaign at its unchanged $50 average daily budget and paused the legacy call-only campaign. The website phone link was also published and checked on desktop and mobile. On September 5, the Calls from ads counting setting was changed from Every to One. Current delivery is established; qualified estimate outcomes still need reconciliation.

work.title: High Intent campaign restarted and legacy campaign paused
work.detail: The existing High Intent Colorado Springs campaign was enabled at its unchanged $50 average daily budget. The legacy Concrete Call Only campaign was paused, and all eight other campaigns were confirmed paused across the full nine-row account view.
work.whyItMatters: Concentrates current serving in the intended campaign with a verified status readback.

work.title: Website click-to-call path corrected and published
work.detail: The existing contact phone number was made clickable with the correct business number in the dialer. The dated receipt records Wix publication and checks of the public link on desktop and mobile.
work.whyItMatters: Removes friction for visitors ready to call without treating a click as a qualified enquiry.

work.title: Call conversion counting changed from Every to One
work.detail: The Calls from ads action was changed to count One, and the setting was reloaded to confirm it persisted. This setting is per ad interaction; it does not deduplicate people across all contacts or establish call quality.
work.whyItMatters: Makes the configured counting method explicit for future reporting.

decisions.decision: The existing High Intent campaign is the sole enabled campaign in the verified recovery view; its $50 average daily budget was preserved.
Calls from ads uses the One counting setting. Business lead qualification remains a separate check.

nextSteps.title: Reconcile calls and forms to estimate opportunities
nextSteps.detail: Confirm connected calls, accepted forms and the resulting qualified estimates before adjusting budget or service emphasis.

nextSteps.title: Validate the form-success measurement path
nextSteps.detail: Check successful submission and the intended conversion event together. A rendered form or installed tag alone is insufficient.

nextSteps.title: Review delivery after the recovery
nextSteps.detail: Monitor the intended High Intent campaign using a clearly dated period and retain the current budget unless a change is agreed.

caveats: Conversion reporting is pending validation. Platform call events are not verified unique people or qualified estimates.
The phone-link change was verified on September 4; this report does not claim a new website production pass on September 8.
Google Ads includes September 8 only through the displayed collection time. The current day is partial and platform reporting is not real time.
